plain_summary_en: This paper studies How News Media Adapt to the Logic of WeChat Video Channels: A Multi-Modal Analysis of News Media Short Videos. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is news media, WeChat, short-form video, video adaptation. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
